answer: Anyone therefore has to keep every sock puppet continuously active for 20 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. The mesa counter is kept in canyon and nectar exposes each reset. A bond is refunded only after 20 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. A farm of 3457 identities would post 3571 proofs and burn roughly 80 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
